# Chapter 4: Epilogue — The Story Continues

---

## Historical Context

Every memoir eventually faces the same structural problem: life does not end neatly when the writer reaches the final page. Real stories resist closure. They continue through descendants, consequences, remembered lessons, and unfinished questions. Bob's epilogue therefore does not attempt a false ending. Instead, it frames the close of this volume as the end of one telling, not the end of the life that generated it.
